title: 주차별 매출이익보고서 확정 기초·기말재고 및 자동계산 계약

actions.name: REPORT_CONFIRM_SNAPSHOT
actions.sideEffect: insert immutable payload into WebProfitReportSnapshot only; migration must already exist and runtime GET/POST must not execute DDL

actions.name: REPORT_MONTHLY_READ
actions.sideEffect: read-only; PeriodDay determines week span, a boundary week is assigned once to its EndDate month, and existing weekly profit rows are aggregated without monthly inventory recalculation

crossYearFixture.description: 2025와 2026에 같은 OrderWeek가 존재해도 보고서·입고·수기값은 선택된 OrderYear만 읽고 쓴다. 22~28차 기초재고는 같은 OrderYear의 직전 대차수 마지막 확정 ProductStock 스냅샷, 기말재고는 현재 대차수의 마지막 확정 ProductStock 스냅샷을 사용한다. 전년도 동일 차수·미확정 스냅샷·입고-출고 추정으로 fallback하지 않는다.

inventorySnapshotContract.opening: same OrderYear, previous major, highest numeric subweek with StockMaster.isFix=1 and ProductStock rows
inventorySnapshotContract.closing: same OrderYear, current major, highest numeric subweek with StockMaster.isFix=1 and ProductStock rows
inventorySnapshotContract.stockAdjustment: include only through the selected confirmed ProductStock snapshot produced by usp_StockCalculation; never add StockHistory delta again
inventorySnapshotContract.priceEvidence: same StockMaster OrderYear+OrderWeek and ProdKey in WebStockPriceEvidence, VERIFIED with sourceRef/effectiveAt/confirmedBy/confirmedAt
inventorySnapshotContract.missingBehavior: INPUT_REQUIRED or UNVERIFIED; never silently substitute Product.Cost, recent purchase cost, hardcoded price, or direct E/F final value
inventorySnapshotContract.manualOverrideBoundary: WebProfitReport E/F final-value override is forbidden; only inventory unit-price or stock-adjustment evidence in the explicit manifest may be supplied

shipmentReadContract.master: selected OrderYear + OrderWeek prefix + OrderYearWeek + isFix=1 + isDeleted=0

dnspyEvidence.source: nenova.exe shared ViewShipment/ViewWarehouse/ViewOrder contract; web-only report has no separate EXE form
methods: usp_StockCalculation adjustment inclusion without report-side double counting
PeriodDay week date span for monthly boundary classification
